import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print(0)
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    
    heights = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    
    if not heights:
        print(0)
        return
    
    max_height = max(heights)
    print(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
